reveals.title: The brother made from a missing book
reveals.belief: Grim had lost a book. Later, the aboleth walked among the company wearing Brother Xanthar’s familiar face.
reveals.unknown: Whether Grim accepted the false childhood memories remains unknown.

reveals.title: Who rules White Plume now?
reveals.belief: Keraptis’s invitation sent the company beneath the mountain. His name would follow the weapons into the north.

reveals.title: The portal that took their belongings
reveals.belief: Biscuit arrived at the grotto naked. Ernie later returned most of the missing gear, but three epic weapons were absent.

reveals.title: The weapons kept their own account
reveals.belief: Terry’s fourfold attunement made the rite possible. The company sacrificed Blackrazor against Pengu; Wave, Whelm and Frostrazor survived.

reveals.title: The village they saved
reveals.belief: The Brotherhood rerouted lava during the assault on the desmodu enclave. The village survived.

reveals.title: What escaped the candle
reveals.belief: Shrop extinguished a candle in the Nightmare Grotto. Later, spells and divine aid began to fail.
reveals.unknown: Pengu’s fighting form fell, leaving a living obsidian egg. Its later fate remains unknown.

reveals.title: The world lived without them
reveals.belief: The dream returned the companions to their eighth-level selves. Their escape carried them twenty years beyond the original present they had left.

reveals.title: The demon inside the dragon
reveals.belief: The company pursued the soul crisis into the Bastion. Ashardalon had survived the loss of his original heart.
reveals.unknown: Ashardalon, Ammet and the unborn souls await the final account.

reveals.title: Another predator wanted the heart
reveals.belief: The Cathezar hunted Thunder because he descended from Dydd, the druid who had wounded Ashardalon.

reveals.title: The doorway had a sister
reveals.belief: Eco was the living entrance to Desayeus’s prison. After her death, Findula left a letter and ended the alliance.
truth: Eco was Findula’s sister. Findula accepted that her choices had helped bring about Eco’s death and believed stopping Ashardalon justified the cost. Her letter declared the debt paid; she wanted no further contact with the company.

reveals.title: The trap’s intended victims
reveals.belief: Biscuit and Gravy fought the ants together. At the Reality Wrinkle, the shared road broke apart.
reveals.unknown: Gravy remains lost in Hell. The trap’s builder and a route home remain unknown.

chains.title: A rescue beneath the earth
chains.intro: The immediate rescue and the disaster it set in motion belong to the same history.

steps.title: The desmodu village survives
steps.text: The Brotherhood diverts lava during the assault and saves the village.

steps.title: Brindinford collapses
steps.text: The altered lava flow causes a volcanic cataclysm during the years the company misses.

steps.title: The desmodu are wiped out
steps.text: That same chain of consequences brings about the extinction of the desmodu during the missing twenty years.

chains.title: A candle extinguished
chains.intro: Follow the release, the failing magic and the northern working that answered it.

steps.title: Shrop snuffs the candle
steps.text: The spirit freed in the Nightmare Grotto is Pengu.

steps.title: Magic drains from the world
steps.text: Spells, divine aid and magical wards fail under Pengu’s influence.

steps.title: The company completes the rite
steps.text: Grim prepares the working; Terry attunes to all four epic weapons; Blackrazor is sacrificed.

steps.title: Pengu’s form falls; the egg remains
steps.text: The final blow leaves a ten-foot obsidian egg. Frostblight collapses, and the company escapes.

steps.title: Magic begins to recover
steps.text: Eldath’s vision confirms the recovery has begun. The later fate of Pengu’s living egg remains unknown.

chains.title: The price the weapons remember
chains.intro: The same sacrifice belongs to the company’s victory and the surviving weapons’ grievance.

steps.title: Four weapons, one bearer
steps.text: Pelor’s boon lets Terry attune to Wave, Whelm, Frostrazor and Blackrazor together.
steps.kind: A boon makes the rite possible

steps.title: Blackrazor is sacrificed
steps.text: The evil, soul-eating blade is given to the completed ritual against Pengu.

steps.title: Three siblings remember
steps.text: Wave, Whelm and Frostrazor hate the Brotherhood for sacrificing their sibling. They will never forgive.

chains.title: A book, a body and a stolen name
chains.intro: Xanthar’s history leads from Grim’s missing possession to White Plume Mountain.

steps.title: Grim’s book is lost
steps.text: Xanthar uses the forgotten knowledge of flesh golems to manufacture Brother Xanthar’s body.

steps.title: The K-vial takes hold
steps.text: Infected, Xanthar believes himself the true Keraptis. His power and constructed body spare him the zombie fate.

steps.title: Xanthar takes White Plume
steps.text: He defeats the reigning K-clone prime and rules the mountain.

steps.title: The portal strips Biscuit’s gear
steps.text: His equipment deception separates the company from its belongings and returns the surviving weapons to his mountain.

steps.title: Ernie returns the other belongings
steps.text: Most gear comes back. Wave, Whelm and Frostrazor remain with Xanthar. Ernie’s complicity is not established.

chains.title: The road that broke away
chains.intro: The ant battle brought both companies together. The next doorway separated them.

steps.title: Eight companions fight the ants
steps.text: Team Biscuit and Team Gravy battle through sunken Brindinford together.

steps.title: The trap takes Gravy
steps.text: A portal intended for Biscuit catches Brunn, Rook, Nox and Elira instead.

steps.title: Still lost in Hell
steps.text: Gravy’s story pauses in Hell while Biscuit continues to Windglum and the Bastion. The trap’s builder is unknown.

chains.title: The hunger the northern victory could not end
chains.intro: Pengu’s defeat allowed magic to recover. Ashardalon’s feeding had its own cause and continued.

steps.title: Ashardalon takes Ammet within him
steps.text: The demon becomes the dragon’s replacement heart after Dydd wounds the original.

steps.title: The replacement begins to fail
steps.text: Ashardalon consumes unborn souls in the Bastion to sustain himself.

steps.title: Twenty years without new souls
steps.text: The gods name the famine while the displaced company returns to unfinished business.

steps.title: The company reaches the dragon
steps.text: The fates of Ashardalon, Ammet and the unborn souls await the final telling.

cast.name: Shrop
cast.text: A fugitive of the Stolen Sons, a breaker of doors, and the companion who kept going first—even without sight.

cast.name: Grim
cast.text: A dragon scholar compiling a great spellbook, following his ancestor Eudostis and bargaining with powers eager to use his curiosity.

cast.name: Terry
cast.text: A sarcastic healer and smith, owner of Zandikar, whose fourfold attunement made the Pengu ritual possible.

cast.name: Thunder
cast.text: A performer turned thief, Brindinford guild insider, heir to a curse, and descendant of the dragon’s ancient enemy.

cast.name: Brunn
cast.text: A dwarf chasing buried steel found a living infestation—and a second company fighting for the same way out.

cast.name: Rook
cast.text: He followed a blight down from the peaks and found himself in tunnels, a falling boat, and the company of rather desperate goblins.

cast.name: Nox
cast.text: A seeker of dangerous sigils found a realm that refused her familiar—and took the refusal personally.

cast.name: Elira
cast.text: The moss witch followed dreams of a black river into the grotto, where its corruption prevented her fey companion from forming.

cast.name: Brother Xanthar
cast.text: The body came from Grim’s missing book. The mountain and surviving weapons now belong to the ruler who calls himself Keraptis.

cast.name: Wave, Whelm & Frostrazor
cast.text: Held safely at White Plume, they remember Blackrazor as their sibling and will never forgive the Brotherhood.

links.label: Read the scene

cast.name: Blackrazor
cast.text: The soul-eating weapon was sacrificed in the completed rite against Pengu.

links.label: Read the scene

cast.name: Pengu
cast.text: Released by Shrop; defeated in the north, leaving a pulsing obsidian egg.

links.label: Read the scene

cast.name: Brother Ernie
cast.text: He recovered most of the company’s equipment, gave four protective rings and departed without explaining his nature or destination.

links.label: Read the scene

cast.name: Dydd
cast.text: The druid mortally wounded Ashardalon’s original heart. Thunder carries the bloodline the dragon’s enemies sought.

links.label: Read the scene

cast.name: Ashardalon
cast.text: He consumes unborn souls to sustain himself and the failing demon within his heart.

links.label: Read the scene

cast.name: Ammet
cast.text: The demon bound inside Ashardalon serves as his failing replacement heart.

links.label: Read the scene

cast.name: Findula
cast.text: She found the route to her sister Eco. After Eco’s death she left, declaring her debt settled.

links.label: Read the scene

cast.name: Eco
cast.text: Findula’s sister guarded Desayeus. Her own body was the entrance to his prison.

links.label: Read the scene

cast.name: Desayeus
cast.text: He yielded the Soul Totem fragment. Thunder carried it out, and Desayeus remained bound.

links.label: Read the scene

cast.name: Pelor
cast.text: His boon enabled Terry’s four attunements. His permission to enter the prison forbade releasing Desayeus.

links.label: Read the scene

cast.name: Captain Pepper
cast.text: Thunder’s pendant binds him to the ghostly ship; dying while wearing it would make him its captive captain.

links.label: Read the scene

cast.name: Aameul
cast.text: He wanted Ammet’s soul, strengthened by stolen life, to survive a separation from the other head.

relationships.title: A brother Xanthar meant to invent
relationships.text: Xanthar used Grim’s missing book for his body and planned false childhood memories of an older brother. Whether Grim believed them remains unknown.

relationships.title: The weapons returned to his mountain
relationships.text: Xanthar’s equipment theft returned Wave, Whelm and Frostrazor to White Plume, where he now keeps them.

relationships.title: Their sacrificed sibling
relationships.text: Wave, Whelm and Frostrazor regard Blackrazor as their sibling. Its sacrifice leaves a permanent grievance.

relationships.title: Four attunements and a grievance
relationships.text: Terry bore all four weapons for the rite. The surviving three hate the Brotherhood for sacrificing Blackrazor.

relationships.title: The blade given to the rite
relationships.text: Terry’s fourfold attunement made the working possible; the company sacrificed Blackrazor.

relationships.title: The Boon of Attunement
relationships.text: Pelor’s boon allowed Terry to attune to all four epic weapons at once.

relationships.title: The spirit he released
relationships.text: Shrop snuffed the candle holding Pengu. The company later fought the spirit in Frostblight.

relationships.title: Wax, wick and the northern working
relationships.text: Grim prepared the ingredients and sets of wax and wick for the ritual against Pengu.

relationships.title: The fourfold working
relationships.text: Terry’s boon and Blackrazor’s sacrifice completed the rite against Pengu.

relationships.title: The blood the dragon feared
relationships.text: Thunder is Dydd’s descendant. That ancestry drew the Cathezar’s pursuit.

relationships.title: The original heart wounded
relationships.text: Dydd mortally wounded Ashardalon’s heart; the dragon survived by taking Ammet within him.

relationships.title: The demon within the heart
relationships.text: Ammet became Ashardalon’s replacement heart. Its failure drove the dragon to feed upon unborn souls.

relationships.title: Dydd’s descendant reaches the Bastion
relationships.text: Thunder brought his bloodline within reach of the dragon. The final outcome remains unwritten.

relationships.title: A soul sought for another ambition
relationships.text: Aameul wanted the soul-charged Ammet to survive the destruction of Hethradiah. This is a scheme, not an accomplished outcome.

relationships.title: A bloodline used as leverage
relationships.text: The Cathezar served Aameul. Thunder’s ancestry was sought as leverage against Ashardalon.

relationships.title: The pendant’s price
relationships.text: Dying while wearing the Ethereal Anchor would make Thunder the Deliverance’s captive captain in Pepper’s place.

relationships.title: Sisters on opposite sides of a doorway
relationships.text: Eco was Findula’s sister. After Eco’s death, Findula left the company a letter ending the alliance.

relationships.title: A guardian bound to the entrance
relationships.text: Eco guarded the prison and could become its doorway. Desayeus remained bound after the company took the fragment.

relationships.title: The fragment carried out
relationships.text: Desayeus yielded his Soul Totem fragment; Thunder carried it from the prison.

relationships.title: Permission to enter
relationships.text: Terry sought Pelor’s permission for passage. The permission expressly forbade releasing the prisoner.

relationships.title: The rings he left behind
relationships.text: Ernie returned most of the gear and gave each companion a Ring of Positive Energy Protection before departing.

remembrance.title: From Oakhurst to the Bastion
remembrance.text: Shrop. Grim. Terry. Thunder. The road began beneath a ravine and led to the birthplace of souls.

image.alt: The company gathered in the campaign farewell film

remembrance.title: The rings came home
remembrance.text: Below Oakhurst, the company searched for the missing Hucreles, freed Erky and reached Belak’s tree. The rings and news returned to the family waiting above.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: Two lives worth turning back for
remembrance.text: The twins needed a way out of Khundrukar. The company arranged it, then descended again. Nightscale waited at the Black Lake.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: A city freed
remembrance.text: Shatterspike was sacrificed to cleanse Pelor’s temple. The company freed the Baron; food, wine and music returned to Brindinford.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: The road through Ossington
remembrance.text: Food and seed, the dead beneath Red Horse Hill, Dyson’s tower and the Horseman’s answers drew the company towards a missing heart.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: The vampire and the heart
remembrance.text: Grim recognised a familiar face among the tombs. Gulthias fell, but Ashardalon’s story continued beyond his original heart.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: They saved the village
remembrance.text: The Brotherhood diverted lava during the desmodu enclave’s assault. The people survived the battle.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: A fortress won; another mystery begun
remembrance.text: Imperagon fell and Terry gained Zandikar. The Cathezar, Thunder’s ancestry and the missing souls drew the company into the Bastion investigation before the later detours.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: A familiar face above the water
remembrance.text: The aboleth returned as Brother Xanthar. His influence would follow the company through the grotto and back to White Plume.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: Their earlier selves
remembrance.text: The Sleeper’s dream returned the company to its own eighth-level lives in Brindinford. Keraptis’s challenge led beneath White Plume Mountain.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: Twenty years beyond home
remembrance.text: They escaped the earlier time and overshot the present they had left. Brindinford had collapsed. The world had lived those twenty years without them.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: When the prayers grew faint
remembrance.text: In Icewind Dale, magic failed and divine aid weakened. The company faced the spirit whose release had begun the calamity.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: Four weapons. One sacrifice.
remembrance.text: Grim prepared the working. Pelor’s boon let Terry attune to all four epic weapons. Blackrazor was sacrificed; the ritual was completed.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: The heartbeat in the ice
remembrance.text: Pengu’s fighting form folded into a ten-foot obsidian egg. Frostblight collapsed. The survivors reached an iceberg, and the gods spoke of magic’s recovery and the continuing soul famine.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: The road home crossed a war
remembrance.text: Angajuk’s passage led towards Acheron. Rigus, the Red Keep, the Reclamation and the demon army stood along the way.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: Nothing on the other side
remembrance.text: Xanthar’s portal delivered Biscuit to the grotto without clothes or equipment. Gravy’s expedition was nearing the same buried city.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: Biscuit and Gravy together
remembrance.text: Eight companions fought giant ants in sunken Brindinford. Beyond the old barracks stood the Reality Wrinkle.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: The fragment and the farewells
remembrance.text: Biscuit reached Windglum. Eco died; Thunder carried Desayeus’s fragment out. Findula left. Ernie returned the gear he could recover and gave four rings before departing.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: The heart inside the Bastion
remembrance.text: The rings carried the company into too much life. Dydd’s descendant reached the dragon whose feeding had denied the world new souls.

links.label: Read this part of the story

remembrance.title: The final account is still to come
remembrance.text: Ashardalon. Ammet. The unborn souls. The eight companions and the lives beyond this door. Their outcomes await the final telling.
